svg.title: Sync achievement badge — clean animation
svg.desc: Original purple hexagon frame and cheering sync artwork. A clean empty frame appears first, then the character springs into place and the gold accent wedges pop in. A gentle hop, soft arrow shimmer and repeating colorful celebration follow. Rough cut fringes and the switching still-image overlay have been removed. Embedded original PNG layers inside an animated SVG. Matching WAV audio supplied separately.
